baseline_models.mechanism: The passive intervention does not extinguish desire; it installs a separator in the relation between desiring subjects and the desired object. The repeated بَيْنَ makes the intervening interval itself the operative site.

activation_trace.role: A barrier literally separates two sides and supplies the operative intervention.
The middle or interval between two sides becomes the space in which access is blocked.
The self's pull toward a desired object remains live on the far side of the separator.

changed_reading.before: They simply fail to obtain what they want.
changed_reading.after: Their wanting persists, but the relation that could carry them to its object is actively severed.

baseline_models.mechanism: A completed operation is repeated across analogous, following cohorts. The present group does not merely resemble an old example; it becomes the next link in a temporally ordered pattern.

activation_trace.role: An enacted operation produces an effect in its recipients.
Following and temporal succession make the current cohort trail an earlier one in action and outcome.
Likeness and counterpart status define the cross-time comparison class.
Temporal precedence orders the earlier cohort before the present repetition.

changed_reading.before: Earlier people supply a loose cautionary comparison.
changed_reading.after: The same operation propagates through a succession of like cohorts, with this group now following its predecessors into the pattern.

baseline_models.mechanism: The construction places them within an enduring condition: alternatives interpenetrate without settling into certainty, while suspicion actively perturbs that condition. Doubt is an inhabited medium, not a passing question.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and presence through time make doubt a sustained condition in which they were situated.
Two possibilities interpenetrate without stable certainty, supplying the unresolved cognitive structure.
Agitated suspicion makes the unresolved structure productive of fear and further doubt.

changed_reading.after: They had dwelt in a self-agitating epistemic condition that prepared the final loss of access.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same doubled بَيْنَ first holds an engineered, measured corridor of intermediate settlements, then receives a request for greater distance and ends in fragmentation. In the focus ayah the connective interval is governed by حِيلَ and becomes an impassable gap; desired remoteness has matured into terminal severance.

activation_trace.role: The focus converts the interval into a literal separator between subjects and desire.
The doubled middle marks the relational space whose function is reversed.
Live desire supplies the destination that the reversed interval no longer reaches.
Making something assume a state establishes the intermediate settlements as connective infrastructure.
The middle between the two sides contains visible settlements and functions as traversable interval.
Deliberate apportioning and planning make travel through the interval ordered rather than accidental.
Going and flowing through the route demonstrate that the earlier between permits movement.
Actively causing distance supplies the requested reversal of the accessible route.
An expanded gap turns the between from a connective middle into sought remoteness.
Tearing into dispersed pieces realizes distance as social and spatial fragmentation.

structural_cues: 34:18 and 34:54 repeat a doubled between construction under opposite governing actions.
34:18-19 moves from measured safe travel to requested distance and comprehensive fragmentation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the accessible network, the request for distance, the tearing apart, and the final barrier; I supply the ironic arrow that chosen distance ripens into inaccessible separation. A live alternative is that these are parallel punishments without a direct causal maturation.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes a generic wall between people and desired objects.
changed_reading.after: It reverses a formerly traversable relational corridor: the distance once requested becomes the interval no desire can cross.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first gathers the parties and promises to open between them by judgment; the focus later places a barrier between them and desire. The barrier can therefore be read as an adjudicated partition produced after the relation has been opened and resolved, not as accidental remoteness.

activation_trace.role: A separator supplies the binding result imposed on the focus relation.
Separation and cutting define the final state of the relation.
Drawing the dispersed sides together supplies the prior assembly for adjudication.
The connection standing between parties is the relation on which judgment operates.
Opening an enclosure by judgment literally supplies the decisive resolution that precedes partition.

structural_cues: 34:26 orders gathering, opening between the parties, and judgment; 34:54 reuses doubled between for the imposed result.
Both constructions act on a relation rather than naming a free-standing object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assembly, judicial opening, and final separation; I infer that the later barrier is the enacted result of that opening. It may alternatively remain a purely eschatological obstruction with no juridical coloring.

changed_reading.before: An unspecified barrier happens to block fulfillment.
changed_reading.after: The blocked access reads as a verdict-like partition imposed once the contested relation has been opened and settled.

context_deltas.mechanism: A conjecture is realized because people follow, while an excepted believing group separates out; the next ayah denies coercive authority and makes doubt the discriminating condition. The focus then joins أَشْيَاع and شَكّ: cohorts are produced through patterned following around doubt, not only noticed after the fact.

activation_trace.role: Following and accompaniment anchor the focus cohort as a repeated behavioral succession.
Unsettled interpenetrating alternatives supply the condition around which following sorts people.
Realization of an expectation closes the loop from conjecture to enacted group behavior.
Conjecture and uncertain supposition supply the anticipated pattern that following realizes.
Successive allegiance turns supposition into a continuing social sequence.
A distinct separated group shows that the sequence sorts rather than absorbs everyone.
The negated coercive force makes patterned following, rather than compulsion, the operative social mechanism.
The repeated doubt branch explicitly names the sorting condition later recalled in the focus.

structural_cues: 34:20 moves conjecture to following with one group excepted; 34:21 explains the discrimination through belief versus doubt.
34:54 places cohort succession and agitating doubt in the same closing sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conjecture, realization, following, exception, absence of coercive force, and repeated doubt; I infer that doubt helps form cross-time affinities. Alternatively, doubt may only label the resulting class without producing its cohesion.

changed_reading.before: Their predecessors merely shared the same mistaken opinion.
changed_reading.after: Repeated following around unresolved doubt generates a lineage of like cohorts and carries each into the same blocked end.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah removes ownership, partnership, backing, unlicensed intercession, and finally every person's power to benefit or harm another. Against that sequence, the focus's group word no longer promises usable solidarity: one activated content of what they desire is rescue through a social network whose channels have all been disabled.

activation_trace.role: Followers, allies, and strengthening groups supply the social support capacity that context dismantles.
Desire remains broad enough to include urgently wanted rescue without being reduced to it.
Possession and disposal name the first support capacity explicitly denied.
Participation or shared stake names a second relational channel explicitly removed.
Strengthening by a backer supplies the helper relation whose absence leaves the group unsupported.
A mediator joining another party supplies the intercessory route restricted by permission.
The renewed denial of disposal makes the loss of reciprocal agency final in the scene.
Partition into one party and another identifies the people between whom aid can no longer pass.
Benefit names the positive transfer that no associate can deliver.
Harm as benefit's contrary completes the removal of reciprocal control.

structural_cues: 34:22-23 enumerates failed ownership, share, backing, and intercession; 34:42 restates the result person-to-person.
The focus retains a cohort term while denying access to what the cohort would now want.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the serial removal of social capacities and the focus's broad desire; I infer desired rescue as one live object of that desire. Other objects, including late assent, return, or former assets, remain materially possible.

changed_reading.before: Each person is independently kept from an unspecified wish.
changed_reading.after: The barrier also blocks the conversion of affiliation into rescue: counterparts and allies remain group labels but cannot transmit benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Affluence releases a town's privileged group into rejection, and wealth plus children are voiced as presumed insulation; earlier rejecters possessed far more yet met denial. The focus's prior counterparts therefore become a recurring social configuration whose desired assets fail as protection.

activation_trace.role: Counterpart likeness lets a recurring social type, not only a named generation, occupy the comparison.
Prior order extends that type backward through repeated historical instances.
Attachment to desired goods supplies the motive for treating assets as insulation.
Expansive luxury that releases its possessor identifies the privileged social position recurring in rejection.
Covering the truth supplies the recurrent response attached to that position.
Accumulated property supplies one desired asset claimed as protection.
Descendants supply the second claimed extension of status and security.
The explicit earlier people connect this boast to a stronger predecessor case.
Not reaching even one tenth quantifies how little present assets can insulate compared with the failed prior case.

structural_cues: 34:34 generalizes a repeated affluent response; 34:35 states its asset-based confidence; 34:45 defeats it by comparison with stronger predecessors.
34:54 closes with both desired objects and prior counterparts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring affluent rejection, the wealth-and-children boast, the stronger prior case, and the final precedent; I infer a durable elite pattern whose assets are desired as insulation. The focus's desire need not be limited to those assets.

changed_reading.before: The prior counterparts are an undifferentiated set of unbelievers.
changed_reading.after: They form a recurring privileged type whose attachment to wealth, descendants, and immunity repeatedly ends in the same loss of access.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truth is cast from disclosed knowledge of the unseen, whereas they cast words toward the unseen from a distant position. In the closing scene accountability seizes them from near, but their late assent attempts a reach from far and cannot arrive. The focus barrier names the asymmetry: projection across epistemic distance cannot be converted into saving access.

activation_trace.role: The final separator fixes the failure of attempted reach.
The still-desired saving object supplies the destination that projection cannot attain.
Unsettled alternatives anchor the earlier epistemic posture behind their distant claims.
Forceful casting supplies the first side of the later projectile symmetry, here carrying truth.
Knowledge as disclosure grounds the source position from which truth is cast.
The hidden domain supplies what the knowledgeable source fully encompasses.
Failure to escape or outrun reach removes the subjects' outward route.
Seizure and capture show accountability successfully reaching its objects.
Nearness marks the effective range from which capture reaches them.
Assent that would settle the heart supplies the saving state now claimed too late.
Extending to take and reach an object supplies the explicit access attempt that fails.
Distance places the desired saving state outside effective reach.
Throwing words supplies their contrasting practice of projecting claims without access.
The unseen as a site of doubt makes their projectile epistemic rather than physically informative.
Repeated remoteness locates their claims beyond grounded contact with their object.

structural_cues: 34:48 and 34:53 repeat casting with opposite epistemic grounding.
34:51-53 opposes effective seizure from near to ineffective reaching and claiming from far, immediately before the focus barrier.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the casting symmetry, near capture, far reach, late assent, and final separation; I infer a reciprocity in which speculative projection cannot later purchase access. A live alternative is the simpler temporal reading that assent is merely too late, without projectile reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: The barrier means only that the opportunity has expired.
changed_reading.after: It is the endpoint of an epistemic-spatial asymmetry: truth and accountability reach them, but their distant projections and late assent cannot reach what would save them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The garden sequence first offers edible provision, then turning away triggers a matched replacement in which two gardens remain two gardens but their yield changes quality. This activates ح و ل as transformation alongside barrier: denied desire can operate through degradation and substitution before the focus's total loss of access.

activation_trace.role: Change from one state to another supplies a transformational layer beneath the final barrier sense.
Appetite for a desired object anchors the material change as a change in desirability.
Eating supplies direct usable access to the original desirable provision.
Turning one's side away supplies the pivot that precedes the material reversal.
One thing standing in place of another preserves the garden frame while replacing its contents.
Changed form or quality makes substitution a degradation of the desired system, not simple disappearance.
The yield of plants names the material output whose desirability has been transformed.

structural_cues: 34:15-16 preserves the count of two gardens across the replacement while changing their produce.
Turning away precedes replacement; the focus later names complete separation from desired objects.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies edible abundance, turning away, matched substitution, altered yield, and final desire; I infer a trajectory from degraded access to blocked access. Alternatively, the garden event may exemplify recompense without defining the focus barrier's material mode.

changed_reading.before: Desired goods are simply removed at the end.
changed_reading.after: The surah first models deprivation as conversion of desirable yield into an undesirable substitute, with the focus barrier as the terminal form of that transformed access.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it transfers armor craft into cognition, but the focus root ش ك ك itself includes piercing, ordered joining, and enclosing armor, while 34:11 supplies complete covering, measured links, and connected piercing. It remains anchored as a model of how doubt can be defensively constructed and then confining; downstream prose should render it explicitly as a material analogy, not as the lexical sense of شَكّ in the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: شَكٍّ joined to حِيلَ as an enclosing result

activation_trace.role: Piercing and stringing items together supply the construction of an interlocked cognitive defense.
Armor enclosing its wearer makes the constructed doubt protective at first and confining at the end.
The final barrier turns the defensive enclosure into loss of outward access.
A long, ample covering supplies the armor's enclosing extent.
Exact measure supplies controlled spacing in the constructed defense.
Successive connected pieces supply the interlocked continuity of the defense.
Piercing that binds rings or leather directly matches the focus root's material branch.

changed_reading.before: Doubt is only wavering or lack of decision.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, doubt is an interlocked defensive armature: claims pierce and reinforce one another until the protection becomes the enclosure that bars escape.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the packet's non-dominant mapping of focus ف ع ل to the fatherhood branch. It remains resolvable and gains context from 34:43, where intended diversion from ancestral worship is alleged, while the focus joins passive action, prior counterparts, and blocked desire. Downstream prose must call this a branch-induced echo about formative inheritance, never an etymology or primary translation of فُعِلَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فُعِلَ بِأَشْيَاعِهِم مِّن قَبْلُ beside مَا يَشْتَهُونَ

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant fatherhood and formation image makes the passive act exploratorily echo inherited shaping.
Following earlier people carries the inherited pattern from predecessors into the present cohort.
Desire supplies the relation finally severed after the inherited polemic is repeated.
Intention and will supply the earlier allegation that the messenger aims at separation.
Diversion and turning away supply the alleged barrier from inherited practice.
Explicit fathers and formation resolve the same mapped branch in the ancestral context.

changed_reading.before: The same unexplained event merely happened to comparable earlier people.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the passive act closes a formative inheritance loop: those who cast warning as intended separation from paternal practice are finally separated from their own desire while following the predecessor pattern.

strongest_changes: The doubled between construction reverses a measured safe corridor into the impassable interval once requested as distance.
Gathering and judicial opening between parties recasts the final barrier as an enacted partition.
Following around doubt forms recurring cohorts, while ownership, partnership, backing, and intercession cease to transmit rescue.
The closing near/far sequence turns speculative projection into failed reach: accountability reaches them, but late assent cannot reach its desired object.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah context repeatedly changed the function of the focus relation rather than merely adding themes: 34:18-19 reverses its spatial infrastructure, 34:26 gives it a judicial phase, 34:20-23 and 34:42 dismantle its social channels, and 34:48-53 expose its epistemic reach asymmetry.
remaining_uncertainties: The object of مَا يَشْتَهُونَ remains deliberately broad; rescue, assent, return, and former assets can coexist without disambiguation.
The maturation from requested distance to final barrier is a reader-supplied ironic arrow, not an explicit causal statement.
The armor analogy and paternal split-root echo are valid exploratory activations but should not displace the stronger spatial, judicial, social, and epistemic models.
